thread:
jess: Heads-up: migration MIG-1024 scheduled for 00:30 UTC. Staging canary showed intermittent lock spikes during backfill sim.
noah: saw that. stacktrace points to our backfill worker hammering updates after ALTER. link: http://staging.logs/mig-1024
priya: suggestion: reduce worker concurrency and add a short sleep between batches. We can release MIG-1024-v1.1 with BACKFILL_CONCURRENCY=2 and SLEEP_MS=200.
deploybot: MIG-1024 scheduled. Current status: PENDING. Auto-pause rules in effect: pause_on_lock_threshold=4/5m. :gear:
jess: let's add a temporary annotation in deploy config: pinned_version: "MIG-1024-v1.1" for midnight window only. no schema changes, just worker flags.
noah: agree. Also add a tourniquet hook to scale down batch_size if lock_count > 2 within 2m.
priya: I'll prepare the ci artifacts and test backfill-sim locally with the new flags.
ci-bot: CI artifacts ready: https://ci/artifacts/1024/v1.1 . Tests: migration-unit, backfill-sim (local), lockwatch-smoke.
jess: ops plan:
1) deploy MIG-1024-v1.1 to 2 canary shards
2) monitor lockwatch and p99 db latency for 20m
3) if lock_count > 3 or any lock > 180s, revert to HOLD and roll back pins
4) if stable, continue phased rollout and unpin at 05:00 UTC
noah: I'll update release notes with the mitigation and pinned version. patch path: infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json
priya: starting canary deploy now. pausing high-concurrency workers on staging and prod canaries.
deploybot: Canary rollout started: shards=2 -> status=IN_PROGRESS. Will enforce pause_on_lock_threshold rules.
jess: monitoring: after 8m no long locks, p99 latency within baseline.
noah: small replication lag spike at +12m but within acceptable bounds. keeping watch.
priya: ran synthetic ALTER+UPDATE thread to try to repro, didn't hit >120s locks with v1.1 flags.
jess: good. continuing to 20% after 25m.
deploybot: Rollout progressed to 20%. No auto-pauses triggered.
noah: hold on unpin until 05:00 as discussed. adding postmortem action: improve backfill-sim to include more concurrent ALTER+UPDATE patterns.
priya: filing run_id=run-1024-20260324-01 for audit and attaching logs.
ci-bot: Reminder: attach CI run_id to release notes. run_id=art-1024-v1.1
jess: closing thread for visibility. any regressions open new thread in eng-releases and ping eng-oncall.
